title: PI0Config (pi0)
description: PI0Config(n_obs_steps: int = 1, input_features: dict[str, lerobot.configs.types.PolicyFeature] | None = <factory>, output_features: dict[str, lerobot.configs.types.PolicyFeature] | None = <factory>, device: str | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = torch.float32, use_amp: bool = False, use_peft: bool = False, push_to_hub: bool = True, repo_id: str | None = None, private: bool | None = None, tags: list[str] | None = None, license: str | None = None, pretrained_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, pretrained_revision: str | None = None, paligemma_variant: str = 'gemma_2b', action_expert_variant: str = 'gemma_300m', chunk_size: int = 50, n_action_steps: int = 50, max_state_dim: int = 32, max_action_dim: int = 32, num_inference_steps: int = 10, time_sampling_beta_alpha: float = 1.5, time_sampling_beta_beta: float = 1.0, time_sampling_scale: float = 0.999, time_sampling_offset: float = 0.001, min_period: float = 0.004, max_period: float = 4.0, use_relative_actions: bool = False, relative_exclude_joints: list[str] = <factory>, action_feature_names: list[str] | None = None, rtc_config: lerobot.policies.rtc.configuration_rtc.RTCConfig | None = None, image_resolution: tuple[int, int] = (224, 224), empty_cameras: int = 0, normalization_mapping: dict[str, lerobot.configs.types.NormalizationMode] = <factory>, gradient_checkpointing: bool = False, compile_model: bool = False, compile_mode: str = 'max-autotune', freeze_vision_encoder: bool = False, train_expert_only: bool = False, optimizer_lr: float = 2.5e-05, optimizer_betas: tuple[float, float] = (0.9, 0.95), optimizer_eps: float = 1e-08, optimizer_weight_decay: float = 0.01, optimizer_grad_clip_norm: float = 1.0, optimizer_fused: bool | None = None, scheduler_warmup_steps: int = 1000, scheduler_decay_steps: int = 30000, scheduler_decay_lr: float = 2.5e-06, tokenizer_max_length: int = 48, text_tokenizer_name: str = 'google/paligemma-3b-pt-224')

n_obs_steps.description: Number of environment steps worth of observations to pass to the policy (takes the current step and additional steps going back).

chunk_size.description: Number of action steps to predict, in openpi called "action_horizon"

n_action_steps.description: Number of action steps to execute

max_state_dim.description: Shorter state and action vectors will be padded to these dimensions

use_relative_actions.description: Relative actions: converts absolute actions to relative (relative to state).

relative_exclude_joints.description: Joint names to exclude from relative (kept absolute). Empty list = all dims relative.

action_feature_names.description: Populated at runtime from dataset metadata by make_policy.

empty_cameras.description: see openpi `preprocessing_pytorch.py` Add empty images. Used to add empty cameras when no image features are present.

normalization_mapping.description: A dictionary that maps from a str value of FeatureType (e.g., "STATE", "VISUAL") to a corresponding NormalizationMode (e.g., NormalizationMode.MIN_MAX)

train_expert_only.description: Freeze entire VLM, train only action expert and projections

scheduler_warmup_steps.description: Scheduler settings: see openpi `CosineDecaySchedule` Note: These will auto-scale if --steps < scheduler_decay_steps For example, --steps=3000 will scale warmup to 100 and decay to 3000

excluded.input_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.output_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.device: always 'cuda'; the GPU is chosen by the scheduler (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
excluded.dtype: torch.dtype is not JSON-serialisable; precision is controlled by train.mixed_precision
excluded.use_peft: set implicitly when train.peft is provided
excluded.push_to_hub: always false; Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action on a model
excluded.repo_id: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.private: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.tags: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.license: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.pretrained_path: set from RunCreate.init_from (model or checkpoint) by the worker
excluded.pretrained_revision: set from RunCreate.init_from by the worker
excluded.rtc_config: inference-time Real-Time-Chunking option, not a training hyperparameter
excluded.compile_model: torch.compile is disabled on the 2-GPU box (P40 unsupported by inductor)
excluded.compile_mode: torch.compile is disabled on the 2-GPU box
